purpose: Allocate blank review-return ledger rows for each package-144 review-packet row, without receiving or ingesting returns, recording decisions, reviewing evidence, approving notice fills, selecting excerpts, copying source text, opening surfaces, or drafting translations.

review_return_boundary.ledger_template_is: blank review-return ledger template for future returns against P144 criteria-decision review-packet rows
review_return_boundary.downstream_gate_policy: return rows are allocated only; all received-return, evidence-review, source-text, excerpt, notice-fill, surface, translation, publication, and pilot gates remain closed
